prerequisites: Digitalisation in Product Development: Mechanical Design, Product Development 1 and 2
CAE Exercise: Technical Mechanics: Statics, Strength of Materials, Dynamics

learning_outcomes.text: Students will engage with various modern and future-oriented technologies and methods of digitalization in the context of product creation.

In the "Digitalization in Product Development" course, key digitalization methods in the product creation process will be taught, including Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data-driven product development and manufacturing, the digital twin, and Extended Reality (XR).

Within the CAE exercise, students will have the opportunity to learn various computer-aided calculation methods and applications, such as Computer Algebra Systems, the Finite Element Method (FEM), and Multibody Simulations (MBS), to solve constructive engineering tasks.

syllabus_topics: Digital Product Development and CAx methods
Extended Reality (XR) with a focus on Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR)
Approximation and model parameterization with MS Excel
Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural optimization with Creo Simulate

assessment_methods.method: Submission of the completed calculation tasks in the form of a laboratory report (CAE Exercise)

assessment_rules: The assessment of the respective subjects is done separately and weighted in a 1:1 ratio. The CAE exercise report is graded and recognized as an examination performance. The knowledge in Digitalization in Product Development is assessed by a graded written exam.
bibliography: Randy H. Shih, Introduction to Finite Element Analysis Using Creo Simulate
